scope: The white masonry Phra That Choeng Chum stupa with its gilt spire and the adjoining four-gabled viharn immediately east.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla own-work original with explicit dedication. Shows the white steps and portal of the stupa alongside the glazed orange and green roofs and three doors of the neighboring hall.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact cleared Mattes original is used for the stupa and Naga-edged roof shapes and material colors. Architectural dimensions and placement use the named native survey and Thai government text.
